title: Finite coefficient Hom evaluation and cocycle predicates
statement: For closed coefficient structures $H_A,H_B$, a coefficient functor $F$ and its tensor comparison $\mu$, define $\operatorname{FiniteHomEvaluation}$ to mean that the actual base-change Hom arrow satisfies reduced evaluation and is the unique arrow with that equation. Define the quotient cocycle predicate by $\alpha_H z=G(v)wH(\alpha_K^{-1},\alpha_M)$ for composable coefficient functors and their specified associator; its intrinsic and etale specializations quantify over all further quotients, including equal levels. The finite site-square predicate is the equality comparing scalar-change then site-change Hom with site-change then scalar-change Hom, using inverse site exchange in the contravariant input. Define $\operatorname{FiniteHomSiteFormula}$ to be this predicate for the recorded etale and pro-etale arrows. Indices $n,m$ mean positive exponents $n+1,m+1$; no invertibility theorem is asserted. The constituent notions are [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] [def-sf-etale-finite-coefficient-hom-arrow] [def-sf-finite-coefficient-site-hom-arrow] [def-sf-finite-coefficient-site-scalar-arrow].
